{"subject":"We've received your daycare request","body":"Hi Mateo,

Thank you for your daycare request for March 15, 2027. A team member will review it and get back to you soon.

If anything changes on your end in the meantime, just let us know.

The Maple Hollow Pet Lodge team"}
